sentence: ___ it was raining, we decided to go for a walk.
explanation: Although + подлежащее + глагол (clause). Despite/In spite of + существительное/герундий, но не clause!

sentence: She went to work ___ feeling unwell.
explanation: In spite of + герундий (V-ing), потому что предлог of требует существительное или герундий, а не clause.

sentence: ___ the cold weather, the children played outside all afternoon.
explanation: Despite + существительное/герундий (но не clause!). Хотя Despite и In spite of синонимы,Despite используется чаще.

sentence: He passed the exam ___ he didn't study very much.
explanation: Although + полный clause (подлежащее + глагол). Despite/In spite of требуют существительное или герундий.

sentence: ___ the traffic jam, we arrived on time.
explanation: In spite of + существительное (the traffic jam). Although/Though требуют после себя clause.

sentence: She smiled ___ she was nervous about the interview.
explanation: Though + подлежащее + глагол (clause). Though — разговорный синоним although.

sentence: ___ his age, Grandpa still goes jogging every morning.
explanation: Despite + существительное (his age). Despite/In spite of + noun; Although/Though + clause.

sentence: We enjoyed the movie ___ the long running time.
explanation: Despite + существительное (the long running time). Although/Though + clause с подлежащим и глаголом.

sentence: ___ she loves cooking, she rarely has time to prepare meals.
explanation: Although + clause (she loves cooking). Despite/In spite of не могут вводить clause напрямую.

sentence: He bought the shoes ___ they were expensive.
explanation: Though + clause (they were expensive). Though и although — синонимы, though более неформальный.

sentence: ___ the heavy snow, the school stayed open.
explanation: In spite of + существительное (the heavy snow). Хотя/Though требуют после себя полное предложение.

sentence: They had a great holiday ___ the bad weather.
explanation: Despite + существительное (the bad weather). Despite и In spite of используются с noun/gerund, не с clause.

sentence: ___ the instructions, I still made a mistake.
explanation: Despite + существительное (the instructions). Although/Though + подлежащее + глагол.

sentence: She didn't give up ___ all the difficulties.
explanation: In spite of + существительное (all the difficulties). Although/Though требуют clause.

sentence: ___ being the youngest, he is the tallest in the class.
explanation: Despite + герундий (being the youngest). Despite/In spite of + V-ing — допустимая конструкция.

sentence: We walked to the station ___ the rain.
explanation: In spite of + существительное (the rain). Although/Though + clause.

sentence: He kept laughing ___ the joke wasn't very funny.
explanation: Though + clause (the joke wasn't very funny). Though и although вводят уступительные придаточные.

sentence: ___ all her efforts, she didn't get the promotion.
explanation: Despite + существительное (all her efforts). Despite/In spite of синонимы, но despite короче и формальнее.

sentence: She went swimming ___ the warning about the strong currents.
explanation: Despite + существительное (the warning). Although/Though + подлежащее + глагол.

sentence: ___ being tired, he finished the project on schedule.
explanation: In spite of + герундий (being tired). Despite/In spite of принимают существительные и герундий, но не clauses.
